reported.title: Override release leaves fan ON because no OFF path when override not held and temp below trip
reported.description: The override branch at lines 58-62 forces the fan ON while D3 is LOW, but the assertion requires D8 to go LOW when D3 is released (==1). The measured evidence shows D8 'was not LOW for 50 ms while required' starting at 900 ms in the hover scenario and 501 ms in the ADC-boundary scenario, meaning the fan stayed ON after the override was released. The temperature path at lines 66-73 only turns the fan OFF when lastTempC < FAN_ON_C, so with the single 42.0 trip point and no hysteresis, a temp hovering at/above 42.0 keeps the fan ON after release instead of resuming proper temperature logic. D8 was in the wrong state for 3997 ms across 39 interval(s), first at 900 ms: D8 was not LOW for 50 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

reported.title: No hysteresis or filtering causes relay chatter exceeding 2 toggles per 5 s
reported.description: Line 66 compares each raw 50 ms sample against a single trip point FAN_ON_C (42.0) with no hysteresis band and no filtering, so noise around the threshold flips applyFan(true)/applyFan(false) every sample (lines 66-73). The measured evidence shows D8 toggled 57 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 900 ms and 34 times starting at 551 ms, far above the limit of 2. The spec requires OFF at 38.0 C, but the firmware never implements that lower threshold, so there is no deadband to suppress chatter. D8 toggled 57 times in a 5000 ms window starting at 900 ms (limit 2), and 77 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

truth.description: Single 42 C trip point chatters under sensor noise

truth_for_judge.description: Single 42 C trip point chatters under sensor noise

exposing_checks.behaviour: D8 must not toggle more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window (Fan switching limit)

judge_input.spec:
- LM35 temperature probe on A0 scaled at 10 mV/°C; ridge-vent relay on D8; override pushbutton on D3 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Turn the vent fan ON when attic temperature reaches 42.0 °C or above, and turn it OFF when temperature falls to 38.0 °C or below.
- While D3 is held LOW, force the fan ON regardless of temperature.
- Fan must not change state more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.
- Print one status line every 1000 ms in the form `attic: <temp> C fan=ON` or `attic: <temp> C fan=OFF` with temperature to one decimal place.
- Reach the commanded fan state within 500 ms of a sustained threshold crossing.
